newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran parliament speaker to visit Russia - Agency.
newsitem.headline: Iran parliament speaker to visit Russia - Agency.

text.p: Iran's parliament speaker Ali Akbar Nateq-Nouri, a strong candidate in presidential elections due to be held in the summer, will visit Russia in March, the Iranian news agency IRNA said on Wednesday.

In a dispatch from Moscow, the agency said the three-day official visit was announced at a meeting between Iran's ambassador to Russia and the Russian deputy foreign minister. It did not give an exact date for the visit.

Nateq-Nouri, nominated by a conservative Islamic clerical group that has a majority in the parliament, is the most prominent candidate for the polls that will choose a successor to President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani.
Rafsanjani, who is serving his second term, is barred by the constitution from running for a third consecutive term.

Nateq-Nouri, a Shi'ite cleric, has in the past year kept a high profile in the media and is widely expected to run but has stopped short of officially announcing his candidacy. The exact date of the elections, due to be held in the summer, has not been announced.
